row:
Physical therapy should feel good when it is done right! If you have had a total knee replacement or you are planning to have one please take a moment to subscribe to my channel for loads of tips and tricks to make the recovery process as painless as possible.

About Anthony Maritato, PT - I have been a licensed physical therapist since 2006 and private practice owner since 2002. I specialize in treating patients who have undergone a total knee replacement or rotator cuff repair surgery.
